title: Ash's Trading Card Textures
description: A pack that gives textures to sarhatabaot's trading card plugin
body:
A pack that gives textures to sarhatabaot's trading card plugin (https://modrinth.com/plugin/tradingcards)

# Includes
- Images for all 136 base cards
- 6 full art legendary boss cards
- Border colour based on rarity
- Unknown card texture for custom cards you add

Thanks to @Silentrebel and the [Giant's Lair](https://giantslair.com/) team for helping make the pack compatible
